# typesense_analytics_rule (Resource)

An analytics rule (Typesense v30+ shape). Aggregates events from a source collection into a destination collection. See the [Typesense API docs](https://typesense.org/docs/30.2/api/analytics-query-suggestions.html).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "typesense_analytics_rule" "popular" {
  name       = "popular_queries_rule"
  type       = "popular_queries"
  collection = typesense_collection.products.name
  event_type = "search"

  params = {
    destination_collection = typesense_collection.popular_queries.name
    limit                  = 100
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `collection` (String) Source collection that emits the events to be aggregated.
- `event_type` (String) Event type to track (e.g. `search`, `click`, `conversion`, `visit`, `custom`).
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Rule type: `popular_queries`, `nohits_queries`, `counter`, or `log`.

### Optional

- `params` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--params))
- `rule_tag` (String) Optional free-form tag attached to the rule for grouping.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--params"></a>
### Nested Schema for `params`

Optional:

- `capture_search_requests` (Boolean)
- `counter_field` (String) For `counter` rules, the field in the destination that stores the running count.
- `destination_collection` (String) Destination collection where aggregated rows are written.
- `expand_query` (Boolean)
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of aggregated rows to keep.
- `meta_fields` (List of String)
- `weight` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import typesense_analytics_rule.popular popular_queries_rule
```
